branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A soft, bloomy-rind cheese made from cream-enriched milk, a brand owned by Savencia (formerly Bongrain). Raw chilled milk is collected every two days from farms within 70 km of the dairies.

sources.text: The brand, the cream-enriched milk, the collection radius and frequency, and Savencia ownership.
